summary: Frontend-only E2E on Expo Web for DIYhomie Blueprint 09 subscription-experience features. All three new features render and route correctly for FREE user demo_home@diyhomie.com. Guided Walkthrough (/home-intel/welcome) loads a real screen (no 404) with progress bar '2 of 4 done · 50%', all 4 step testIDs (welcome-step-profile/property/rooms/assets), completed steps show strikethrough + 'Completed', incomplete steps show CTA (welcome-cta-<key>) that navigates correctly, and welcome-finish ('Skip for now') POSTs /api/hi/account/onboarding/complete (200) and returns to /home-intel. Upgrade Nudge (hi-upgrade-nudge) renders warning-styled 'You've reached your homes limit · 3 of 1 used · tap to see plans' and routes to /home-intel/upgrade. Plan Perks screen (/home-intel/perks) shows Free plan badge, 'What you get today' unlocked list with green checks, 'Unlock with Pro' locked list, and perks-upgrade button routes to /home-intel/upgrade. account-plan-card in /home-intel/account correctly routes FREE user to /home-intel/upgrade. No console errors during flows.
critical_code_review_comments: welcome.tsx `finish()` calls router.replace('/home-intel') inside the try/finally regardless of success — good UX but silently swallows errors; consider surfacing a toast on failure so users know retry.
perks.tsx pro upsell list uses `plans.pro.highlights` instead of a dedicated locked-perks payload — cosmetic but works; comment in code already acknowledges this.
seed_data_creation: None. Note: welcome-finish test flipped demo_home's onboarding_complete to true on backend (as expected by request). Banner will no longer appear on subsequent visits until backend state is reset — flag for main agent if further onboarding-banner testing is needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: demo_home@diyhomie.com onboarding_complete was toggled to true during welcome-finish test. To retest the hi-onboarding-banner, reset that flag on the demo user (e.g., PATCH the users collection or re-seed).
